field_evidence.dataset_title: Primary fires in schools in London
field_evidence.resource: Fires in schools 2013 to 2018 - to end August 2018

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade Primary fires in schools in London dataset. The dataset covers primary fires in nursery, infant/primary and secondary schools, provides incident date/time, school name/address, postcode, borough/ward and fire-cause fields, and the published machine-readable window runs from January 2013 through August 2018. This batch binds the verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused official ward-capable source window without extracting incident rows, geometry, parcel joins or parcel progress.
